== Description ==
Original Japanese [[What're You Tryin' To Push On Us? (Japanese)|What're You Tryin' To Push On Us?]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]], black-border printing. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
